title: FallbackFontTextMeshPro uses arialuni_sdf-u55to2017 instead of u2018 due to Unity 2018.3 AssetBundle version mismatch
reason: The arialuni_sdf_u2018 and arialuni_sdf_u2019 bundles were built for Unity 2018.4+ and cannot be loaded by the game which runs Unity 2018.3.0. The u55to2017 bundle is already present and backward-compatible with Unity 2017-2018.3 runtime.
correct_fix: Rebuild the arialuni_sdf font AssetBundle targeting Unity 2018.3 and replace the u55to2017 shim with the proper versioned bundle.
